tools.description: Generate professional, editable SVG artwork from a text prompt: illustrations, icons, stickers and mascot scenes. The result is real vector paths with a transparent background, not an embedded bitmap. Returns a task that processes asynchronously, so call wait_for_task with the returned id to get the result. Pass mascot_id (from list_mascots) to keep a consistent character across scenes. Costs 4 credits.

mascot_id.description: Optional mascot id; the character appears consistently in the scene

no_background.description: Return only the subject on a transparent background

prompt.description: What to draw, in plain language

tools.name: generate_illustration
tools.title: Generate SVG artwork

tools.description: Generate a professional vector logo as editable SVG, delivered as a brand kit: the original mark, black and white variants, transparent PNG exports and a color palette measured from the finished artwork. An optional reference can refine an existing identity or provide loose inspiration. Runs asynchronously, so call wait_for_task with the returned id, then download_logo_kit. Costs 8 credits.

brand_name.description: Exact optional brand name; omit for symbol-only

tools.name: generate_logo
tools.title: Generate vector logo and brand kit

tools.description: Convert a raster image (PNG/JPG/WebP, max 5 MB) into a clean, editable SVG. Provide image_url or image_base64. no_background defaults to true and isolates the subject (4 credits). Set no_background false with mode 'direct' to trace as-is (1 credit); mode 'enhance' redraws with AI first (4 credits). Runs async, so poll with wait_for_task.

image_base64.description: Base64 image data (raw or data URL)

no_background.description: Isolate the subject on a transparent background

tools.name: vectorize_image
tools.title: Vectorize image

tools.description: Fetch the current status of a task. Status is one of queued, processing, succeeded, failed. A succeeded task includes the result with download URLs.

task_id.description: Task id from generate_illustration or vectorize_image

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get task status

tools.description: Block until a task settles (succeeded/failed) or the timeout passes. Preferred over polling get_task in a loop. Generation typically takes 10-60 seconds.
tools.name: wait_for_task
tools.title: Wait for task to finish

tools.description: List the user's most recent tasks, newest first.
tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List recent tasks

tools.description: List the user's ready-to-use mascots (consistent characters). Pass a mascot id to generate_illustration to place that character in a new scene. Mascots are created in the CleanVector dashboard.
tools.name: list_mascots
tools.title: List mascots

tools.description: Return the finished artwork as a PNG image (free on all plans). Use after a task succeeded. For larger exports up to 8192px, use the png_url from the task result with the same Bearer key.

variant.description: Logo only: original/black/white. Artwork tasks have one SVG.

width.description: Output width in px (height keeps aspect)

tools.name: download_png
tools.title: Download result as PNG

tools.description: Return the finished artwork as SVG markup. Use after a task succeeded.
tools.name: download_svg
tools.title: Download result as SVG

tools.description: Return a completed logo kit as an embedded ZIP resource. Includes three SVGs, three PNGs and palette.json. MCP output is capped at 2048px; use zip_url from the task result for larger files.
tools.name: download_logo_kit
tools.title: Download logo brand kit

tools.description: Current plan and credit balance. Costs: vectorize 1, generate/enhance 4, logo 8 credits. PNG and SVG downloads are free on every plan.
tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account info
